dish.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon, Green Olives, and Couscous

recipe_version.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon, Green Olives, and Couscous
recipe_version.description: Bone-in chicken thighs braised with grated onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and saffron in a covered Dutch oven until tender, finished with preserved lemon, green olives, cilantro, and parsley, served over fluffed couscous.

ingredients.name: bone-in skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.display_name: bone-in skinless chicken thighs (8, about 5 oz each)

ingredients.name: preserved lemon
ingredients.display_name: preserved lemon whose label lists lemons, salt, and water

ingredients.name: green olives
ingredients.display_name: pitted green olives whose label lists olives, water, salt, and lactic acid

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Season the chicken with 1 1/2 tsp salt. Grate the onions on the box grater, mince the garlic, slice the preserved lemon rind, and chop the cilantro and parsley. Crumble the saffron.

steps.title: Brown lightly
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium, about 2 minutes. Brown the thighs lightly in 2 batches, about 3 minutes per side, and set aside.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.body: Add the grated onions and garlic and cook, stirring, until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the ginger, turmeric, and saffron, then the 1 cup water, scraping the bottom.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Return the chicken in 2 layers, bring to a simmer, cover, and braise on low, turning once, until 175 F at the bone and tender, about 40 minutes. Uncover, add the preserved lemon and olives, and simmer until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes. Stir in half the herbs.

steps.title: Steep the couscous
steps.body: During the last 10 minutes of the braise (overlap stated): bring 1 1/2 cups water, 1 tbsp oil, and 1/4 tsp salt to a boil in the covered 2-quart saucepan, about 4 minutes. Stir in the couscous, cover off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with the fork.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon couscous onto plates, top with chicken and sauce, olives, and lemon rind, and scatter with the remaining herbs.
